# Coaching Session 2026-02-09

First of twelve sessions with [[miriam-oduya|Miriam Oduya]].

## What we did

Miriam asked me to list everything I had done in the previous two weeks and mark each item: only I can do this, someone else could do it now, someone else could do it with three months of help. Of 41 items, I marked 9 as only-me. She asked me to justify each of those 9 and I could defend 4: the Meridale architecture commitments, fundraising support for Renata, the final say on hiring, and the board update.

## What I took away

- I was incident commander for every incident in 2025, including the small ones, because I knew the system best. That is a reason for me to be consulted, not to command.
- The release checklist, the AWS bill review and the first pass on security questionnaires are things I do because I always have.
- She introduced the [[levels-of-delegation]] scale. Handing something over without saying which level causes most of the "I thought you wanted me to decide" moments.

## Commitment

Pick one thing to hand over by the next session. I picked release coordination, then did not do it until July ([[release-train-handover-2026-07-14]]). Incident command went first, but because of the outage, not because of the plan ([[a-founder-should-not-stay-incident-commander]]).
